lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: OK. On the way back up, what did you do with the plates? Again, Teresa's here and she's thanking you for being honest. Do you know what he did with the plates?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: You don't? Is that the truth?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: You say that right in front of Teresa now?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Cuz this is your chance to help her, right?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: OK. And when you went home that night around 10:00 o'clock, are you sure your mom was home or could you be mixing that up with another night.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: OK, then later than 10:00? Earlier? Or don't know?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: OK. The bed sheets and the bedding, do you know whether or not that was taken off and burned, cuz the first time you said you, you thought it was. Again we just want the truth, not what other people are saying, Teresa wants the truth, the Halbachs aren't gonna be happy with you that you did this, but they're gonna be happy that you're tellin' the truth, you understand that, right? OK, the sheets and the bedding, did it get destroyed or not?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: He did that, you see him do that?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: How do you know he did that?
